title: The Case of the Missing Wallet
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律体系与遵纪守法）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律体系与遵纪守法）　|　核心词汇：case　|　正文 303 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 case 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Last term our class ran a mock trial. The ① case was simple: a boy was said to have taken a wallet from the locker room. Our teacher, who had worked as a lawyer for six years, warned us that no trial is ever won by shouting.

I was on the defence team. Our ② case for the boy rested on one fact: he had been ill that afternoon. The school nurse's record showed three ③ cases of the same stomach bug that day, and his name was among them. Without that note we would have had nothing. ④ In that case, our defence would have fallen apart in a minute.

Then the other side produced a red guitar ⑤ case that had been found beside the lockers. The wallet lay inside it. In such a ⑥ case, the smallest detail decides everything: whose guitar case was it, and why was it left there? We argued that a guitar case in a locker room proves nothing, since half the school plays an instrument. But the other side had a witness — a cleaner who had seen the boy carrying the case that morning. We had nobody to match her.

The trial lasted two hours. We lost, and we lost fairly: the owner of the guitar case turned out to be the boy himself, who had moved the wallet by mistake while looking for his own bag. Afterwards our teacher said only one thing: 'Never build a ⑦ case on a single fact.'

Since then I keep a small notebook. Before I judge anyone — a classmate who is late, an ⑧ case of cheating reported in the corridor — I write down what I actually know. ⑨ In any case, I check twice before I speak once. And ⑩ in case I forget, I have copied my teacher's sentence on the first page.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 情况；情形；事例
B. n. 案件；案例（需查证或审理的事）
D. n. 箱子；盒子（用于装运或存放）
E. n. 论据；理由（the case for / against）
F. 固定搭配：in any case 无论如何
G. 固定搭配：in that case 既然那样
H. 固定搭配：in case 万一；以防（后接句子）

items.q: Our case for the boy rested on one fact
three cases of the same stomach bug
In that case, our defence would have fallen apart
In such a case, the smallest detail decides everything
Never build a case on a single fact
an case of cheating reported in the corridor
In any case, I check twice

answers.why: 与 mock trial 呼应，指模拟法庭上要审理的这桩“案子”，取“案件；案例”。
the case for sb 指“为某人辩护的理由、论据”，后接 rested on one fact（建立在一个事实上）。
与 nurse's record、stomach bug 呼应，指三“例”同样的肠胃病，取“病例”。
in that case 是固定搭配，意为“既然那样”，承接上一句“如果没有那张记录”。
被 red、guitar 修饰，且钱包装在里面，指装吉他的“箱子”，取具体物品义。
in such a case 指“在这样一种情况下”，取“情况；情形”。
build a case on sth 指“把论据建立在……上”，老师提醒不能只凭一个事实就立论。
an case of cheating 指作弊“这件事、这个事例”，与 a classmate who is late 并列举例。
in any case 是固定搭配，意为“无论如何”，表明无论什么情况都要先核实。
in case + 句子，意为“万一、以防”，此处 in case I forget 表示“以防我忘了”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 无论如何，开庭前我们都会把证据核对两遍。（in any case）
既然那样，我们就得另找一位证人。（in that case）
把这份记录带上，万一老师问起。（in case）
校医那天报告了三例同样的肠胃病。（cases）
辩方的论据只建立在一个事实上。（the case for）
这件案子教会我：先看证据，再下判断。（case）
answers: In any case, we will check the evidence twice before the trial begins.
In that case, we will have to find another witness.
Take this record with you in case the teacher asks.
The school nurse reported three cases of the same stomach bug that day.
The case for the defence rested on a single fact.
This case taught me to look at the evidence before I judge.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 case 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Last month our class held a mock trial so that we could see how a real court works.
In that case, the witness was a cleaner, and her words changed everything.
The case for the boy rested on a nurse's note, which was legal evidence.
Our teacher, a former lawyer, told us never to build a case on a single fact.
In any case, an innocent person should be protected before he is judged.
Justice means that every case is decided by truth and fair argument, not by who speaks loudest.
